description: A call to an unmarked bodyless callee floors to throwing and is reported at the call, with the two-clause floor message.

diagnostics.message: Call to `decode` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it is declared without a body — an ambient declaration, a `.d.ts`, or a value known only by its function type — and no mark, manifest, overlay, override or baseline entry colors it, so it is assumed to throw. Your outs, in precedence order: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`; assert the color in `nothrow.overrides.json`; install or write an `@nothrow/*` overlay; or, if you own the package, ship a manifest with `nothrow emit`.
